instruction: Candid outdoor full shot of two women dancing on a grassy lawn. On the left, the smiling woman in the maroon patchwork dress (R2) stands barefoot, facing right with her arms outstretched. On the right, the woman in the peach and blue dress (R1) faces left, also barefoot with her arms extended as she dances. The two women face each other, performing synchronized dance movements. The background shows lush green bushes and trees under warm, natural daylight.
